meta.title: Take business rules out of your code
meta.description: Ordo is an open-source business rule engine. Let it handle pricing, risk and approval decisions that change often. See what a change affects before you make it, and ship it without a redeploy.

hero.subtitle: Let Ordo handle the pricing, risk and approval decisions that keep changing. See what a change affects before you make it, and ship it without a redeploy.
hero.shot_alt: Ordo Studio showing a loan approval ruleset as a flow

items.title: Rules in one place
items.desc: Discounts, limits and risk thresholds stop hiding in code. Business teams can read them, and every change is recorded.

items.title: See the impact first
items.desc: Before you move a number, see which decisions change and what they change to.

items.title: Live without a release
items.desc: Updated rules take effect right away. Your application code stays the same, with no redeploy.

impact.title: Change one number, see who it affects
impact.p1: The risk team wants to block payments from a score of 65 instead of 70. After the edit, every test still passes.
impact.p2: Ordo runs the old and new rules side by side and finds 5 cases that move from "add a check" to "block". You decide before the change goes in.
impact.ai: Whether a person or an AI made the change, it goes through the same check.

panel.rest: The other 125 cases stay the same

studio.title: Rules your whole team can read
studio.desc: See the same rules as a flow or as a table. Business teams read the logic, run tests and request releases there. Engineers keep working in the code repository.
studio.shot_alt: Ordo Studio showing the same loan approval ruleset as a decision table

cta.title: Start from a ready-made example
cta.desc: Credit approval, promo stacking and fraud scoring, already written. Copy one and change it to your own policy.

footer.desc: An open-source business rule engine. Take the decisions that change often out of your code, and see what a change affects first.
